relationships.subject: BoNT-E
relationships.evidence_quote: The subcutaneous administration of BoNT-E significantly reduced formalin-induced nociceptive behaviors and CFA-induced thermal hyperalgesia.

relationships.subject: BoNT-E
relationships.evidence_quote: The subcutaneous administration of BoNT-E at a dosage of 10 units/kg significantly decreased the number of c-fos-immunoreactive neurons evoked by air-puff stimulation in rats with an inferior alveolar nerve injury

relationships.subject: BoNT-E
relationships.evidence_quote: BoNT type E (BoNT-E) inhibits SNARE-mediated synaptic vesicle fusion by cleaving synaptosomal-associated protein 25 (SNAP-25)

key_findings: Subcutaneous BoNT-E reduces formalin, CFA and inferior alveolar nerve injury pain behaviors without motor impairment
